Chapter 68 Cooperation With The Deserted City (One More Chapter)

Hearing this, the two were silent.

Why dare?

At this moment, they were a little afraid to guess.

Seeing that the two of them were not talking, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

The eyes are still too short-sighted.

But it’s no wonder that others are, who makes me really invincible?

After a long time, Li Changyue suddenly spoke, "Lord of the Huangcheng City, I wonder if my Changsheng Immortal Clan can become an affiliated force of the Huangcheng City?"

Hearing this, the Immortal Clan and the Immortal Clan all looked at Li Changyue in horror.

"Class leader, why?"

The people of the Changsheng Immortal clan looked at their clan leader in disbelief.

They couldn't believe that this sentence was spit out of their patriarch's mouth.

You should know that when the human race was so powerful, the immortal race of the immortal race had no idea of clinging to each other, but chose to escape from the world.

Di Ming was also a little shocked, but then he reacted, and for a moment, he frowned.

Above, Lu Daosheng thought.

He knew what the other person was thinking.

The last disaster in the All Spirit Realm destroyed the brilliant human race.

The immortal clan and the immortal imperial clan spent a huge price to escape the world, and even caused the entire clan to fall asleep and finally escaped the disaster.

But, next time, next time.

They can't deal with the World Alliance at all, so they can only find a strong backer.

Obviously, Li Changyue chose the deserted city.

And I also believe in the strength of Huangcheng.

I have to say that Li Changyue is very brave and has a good vision.

After pondering for a moment, Lu Daosheng finally nodded.

"Yes."

This immortal clan of immortals has been passed down for endless years, and its foundation is unimaginable.

Although his deserted city is not weak, he still lacks the sedimentation of time.

It's just that time is still too short.

Letting the immortal clan join this life will also add some advantages.

And with him here, he was not afraid that the immortal immortals would dare to do anything to betray the wasteland city.

He has this confidence.

When Li Changyue heard Lu Daosheng agree, he immediately smiled.

"I'm here, thank you Lord Huang."

On the side, Emperor Ming, the leader of the Immortal Emperor clan, opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but in the end he still didn't speak.

This scene was naturally seen by Lu Daosheng, but Lu Daosheng didn't say anything.

If the other party wants to join, he will not refuse.

But if the other party doesn't mention it, he won't mention it either.

After all, even if there is no Immortal Clan in the Desolate City or the Immortal Clan, it will still be fine.

As for that world alliance.

When soldiers come, generals come and prevent them, and when water comes and soil comes and cover them.

If he really can't beat him, Lu Daosheng will be there.

"Are you two interested in the emergence of the relics of the three major human forces?"

Seeing these people stop talking, Lu Daosheng took the initiative to smile.

Upon hearing this, Di Ming said first: "Lord of the Wilderness City, my Immortal Emperor Clan is very interested in this. I wonder if I can cooperate with the Wilderness City and work together to make it."

On the side, Li Changyue also said, "There are also my immortal clan in the immortals."

Hearing the two of them answered, Lu Daosheng nodded and said, "Okay, then the three of us must help each other."

Immediately, Gu Chen Yunqi and others came to the hall.

"Master Lord!"

Lu Daosheng nodded.

"These two are the patriarchs of the Immortal Clan and the Immortal Emperor Clan. They want to cooperate with my deserted city to explore the remains."

"Next, you guys have some communication."

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

In the hall, the Immortal Clan and the Immortal Clan were shocked when they saw Gu Chen and others.

What a strong aura.

Although there is no realm of destiny.

But they all have strong auras and are not weaker than the existence of the Heavenly Destiny Realm.

It is hard to imagine how these strong men in the deserted city practice.

Soon, Gu Chen and others discussed the issue of exploring the remains of the three major human forces.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly and left immediately.

Although these ruins were full of dangers in his deductions, he believed that his subordinates would definitely be safe.

What's more, there was a backup plan left by themselves in their bodies, and the sky in the Potian Realm was staring at them in the dark.

There will definitely be nothing wrong.

As for the immortal clan and the immortal imperial clan, the two clans can survive for endless years and are still safe and sound, so they are naturally somewhat capable.

Lu Daosheng never looked down on them.

So if these two tribes follow, you will feel completely relieved.

In a secret space opened in the city lord's mansion.

Lu Daosheng sat in it, with countless mysterious patterns all over his body.

Every pattern seems to represent something.

Huh ~

He let out a light breath and all the lines were extinguished.

"The realm of true self,"

Lu Daosheng murmured to himself.

There are nine realms between the realm of destiny and the realm of true self.

Every realm is different.

Staring at his hands, Lu Daosheng remained silent for a long time and finally used the deduction method.

Soon, a picture appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

I saw several powerful figures sitting cross-legged on the top floor above a black tower that reached the sky.

"Battle Alliance?"

Lu Daosheng spoke.

Suddenly, the figures opened their eyes instantly.

"who!?"

However, looking around, I saw no one, nor did I feel any breath.

Several people frowned.

A figure with the strongest aura first reacted and then said, "Your Excellency, is there something wrong with looking for my World Alliance?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng said indifferently: "That's right."

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, the figures trembled all over.

What exactly does the other party exist? I and others cannot sense it at all.

Suddenly, a drop of cold sweat slowly fell from several people's cheeks.

"What the hell is it that you are?"

Lu Daosheng sneered, "Is this a big deal or a small deal?"

Hearing this, the few people were a little confused.

So, what exactly is it?

At this time, Lu Daosheng continued, "I think you are unhappy and want to beat you up. Do you have any objections?"

Hearing this, the few people were stunned.

However, the next moment, an illusory giant palm appeared above the heads of several people.

"What!?"

boom!

With a roar, it sounded.

The entire black tower shattered.

And those figures were neatly lying in the ruins, looking at the sky with a confused look on their faces.

He was beaten for no reason. . .

What kind of existence is that it actually makes them have no ability to resist.

In the deserted city, Lu Daosheng looked at the scene in front of him and then took his hand back.

At this time, Lu Daosheng's expression was a little solemn.

Unexpectedly, this world alliance is so powerful.

Although he was still like an ant in front of him, he was much stronger than the current deserted city and the current world of all spirits.

And he took action to win more time for the world of all spirits.

Next, the entire world of all spirits, including the deserted city, must have a great improvement. Otherwise, if the world alliance arrives and you don’t take action, the world of all spirits will probably be over.

After all, his intention to create a force was not to recruit a group of little cabbages to protect them.

Are you full?

Just then, the system sounded.

[Host, you have the ability to find a wife now. Wouldn't you try it? 】

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was silent.

He has indeed already.

If you can't even achieve the realm of the true self after you have improved to the realm of ten.

Then, this wife, it’s better not to.

Whose wife is so scary? !

After a long silence, Lu Daosheng said slowly, "Let's go in the future, maybe, the time comes, and we will naturally meet."

For some reason, Lu Daosheng didn't think about it anymore.

This emotion is complicated.

Now, it's pretty good.

But not looking for it doesn’t mean not loving it. On the contrary, he loves his wife very much.

But after so many years, will the other party really not change?

At this moment, he was in a mess.

Shaking his head, Lu Daosheng stopped thinking about these things.

It’s better to do your career with peace of mind.

Seeing this, the system no longer says anything.
